identity.title: Implement OpenAIRE provider and real data snapshot

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Connect the application to real OpenAIRE data through one small provider boundary. Timebox the hackathon OpenAIRE MCP/Alien quick-start to 90 minutes; if it works, use it as primary. If not, stop the spike and ship the stable V3 REST provider. Fetch only counts, recent publication buckets and representative evidence needed by OpenGap.
human_pressure.why_now: The artifact has no value if OpenAIRE is only decorative; real data must work before UI polish.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: Do not ingest the full OpenAIRE Graph.
Do not add a graph database.
Do not page through complete result sets.
Do not make MCP protocol details leak into domain/UI types.
Do not spend more than 90 minutes debugging MCP/Alien integration before activating the V3 REST fallback.

machine_core.goal: Implement one OpenAIRE provider contract, attempt the supplied MCP/Alien path within a strict 90-minute timebox, and guarantee a V3 REST delivery path with finite timeout, response mapping and explicit failure semantics.
red_lines: Do not ingest the full OpenAIRE Graph.
Do not add a graph database.
Do not page through complete result sets.
Do not make MCP protocol details leak into domain/UI types.
Do not spend more than 90 minutes debugging MCP/Alien integration before activating the V3 REST fallback.
invariants: header.numFound is the count source for matching queries.
Representative evidence comes from the same provider query family.
contracts: OpenAireProvider returns a compact snapshot of counts, year buckets and evidence only.
failure_semantics: Timeout/rate-limit/provider failures abort the analysis finding.
Never generate a gap from incomplete required metrics.

steps.title: Timebox MCP/Alien integration
details: Use the official hackathon quick-start/credentials already supplied to the participant.
Stop after 90 minutes if there is no reliable real OpenAIRE query; do not redesign the app around MCP debugging.
If successful, keep MCP behind the same compact provider contract.

steps.title: Implement research-product queries
details: Query publication, software and dataset counts using header.numFound.
Retain only a few result records as evidence.

steps.title: Implement project query
details: Query project count and representative project evidence.

steps.title: Implement trend buckets
details: Fetch only the year-window counts required by mvp-1 trend logic.
Exclude partial current year from complete-year comparison.

steps.title: Implement failure semantics
details: Provider error/unknown must not become zero.

acceptance: A real OpenAIRE query works through MCP or the documented V3 REST fallback; the chosen path is stated explicitly.
Real OpenAIRE responses map to non-negative counts and evidence.
Provider failure is explicit and does not fabricate zeros.
Mapping tests cover missing optional fields.

must_check: A real OpenAIRE query works through MCP or the documented V3 REST fallback; the chosen path is stated explicitly.

reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
